feature: Customer Home / Overview - the real artifacts/portal '/' page (src/pages/index.tsx), wired to the two real endpoints traced in docs/portal/customer-home-and-timeline-contract-pack.md: GET /api/portal/dashboard (artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-customer-engines.ts, requireAuth) and GET /api/portal/customer/timeline (portal-customer-timeline.ts, requireRole Customer). Backs the page's header state banner, Needs You / Coming Up / Happened / Work In Flight / Portal Counts / Reports panels - see src/components/overview/ for the data hooks and src/pages/index.tsx's own header comment for the one deliberate design departure (no gantt/calendar strip - see that comment for why).
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: both endpoints are auth-gated as documented, a logged-in customer gets the real dashboard shape (scores/telemetryStatus/results/projects/reports/overviewCounts, including the #2922 six roll-up counts) and the real timeline shape (events[]/nextCursor), and the timeline's cursor param actually narrows the result.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT COVER, AND WHY (no portal login page yet): artifacts/portal has no login page today (#1648) - App.tsx's RequireAuth renders an honest 'Sign in required' panel for an unauthenticated visitor. A real end-to-end UI login -> land on Overview -> see real customerName/counts flow cannot be exercised through the browser yet, the same structural gap test-manifests/portal/alerts-dropdown.json (#1821) and test-manifests/chat/support-chat-active-cards.json (#2519) already document. The uiSteps below only assert what is honestly reachable today (the shell route mounts and RequireAuth's honest empty state renders). apiTests exercise the full real backend directly with a real bearer token. Once a portal login page exists, extend this manifest with a real login block + goto '/' + assert on real rendered data-testids (overview-notifications-chip / overview-messages-chip are already on the page) - no code change needed on the page side.

LIVE RUN RESULT (2026-09-06, session for #2921, run via shaneapp://runTest against the real local dev api-server on :8080): 8 of 9 steps passed - every apiTests step (auth gates, real login, real dashboard shape incl. overviewCounts.rbdWaiting, real projects[]/reports[] arrays, real timeline events[]/nextCursor shape, the before= cursor param accepted) passed against live data. The one uiSteps navigate step failed with a Navigation Error because the artifacts/portal Vite dev server (:5173) was not running in that environment at run time (confirmed: curl to :5173 refused the connection, :8080 answered normally) - this branch's frontend had not yet gone through the dev-server merge/restart cycle that starts it. Not a code defect; re-run once the portal frontend dev server is up.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use).

#3344 addition (2026-09-09): wired the real no_tenant_scope state into index.tsx (SCOPE UNRESOLVED state badge, 'No resolvable tenant identifier to schedule against.' Coming Up copy, and the Portal Counts note line — all matching Overview.dc.html's own state legend/copy verbatim). No reliable frontend signal existed for this before this build; overviewCounts alone can't disambiguate a real quiet week from resolveTenantScope(customerId) returning null, so the route now also emits tenantScopeResolved: boolean (see DASHBOARD-TENANTSCOPE apiTests step, sessionTag 3344-no-tenant-scope).

#4062-#4068 addition (2026-09-14): six real findings from the Dashboard contract-pack regen (#4056, parent Feature #1943), all fixed in one coordinated build. New overviewCounts fields: poamsOverdue + poamsApproachingExpiry (#4062, real msp_poams read — none existed before), openRisks + openRisksWithPlan (#4063, real Risk Register 'Open' count + the checkKey/additionalCheckKeys linkage to a live POA&M, since spawnedByPoamId/convertedToPoamId on msp_risk_decisions are one-time conversion pointers, not this relationship), sopsRunning + sopsQueued + sopsExecsThisMonth (#4064, the real queueStateFor() split — no 'waiting on customer' state exists separate from Queued, so this reports the two real states plus the aggregate execsThisMonth fallback the issue itself named), changeRequestsAwaitingApproval + freezeActive (#4065, reusing portal-change-control.ts's own displayStatus()/isWindowActiveAt() rather than re-deriving), and microsoftChangesThisWeek now counts kindForPost() === 'd'||'b' over the whole corpus instead of a raw 7-day date window (#4066, same field name, corrected meaning). scores.* now reads null instead of 0 for an engine that has never produced a snapshot for this customer (#4068), matching results.summary.compositeScore's existing null pattern. Verified against the real live local testbed data for customer_id=1 (tenant c4c814d4-3afe-441e-9145-62461d0a4fd3, msp_id=1) queried directly via DATABASE_URL before writing the apiTests below: one msp_poams row exists but is soft-deleted (deleted_at set) so poamsOverdue/ladder correctly read all-0; one Open msp_risk_decisions row (id=87) with a null check_key, so openRisks=1 and openRisksWithPlan=0 (no live plan to link to); zero msp_sop_runs rows so sopsRunning/sopsQueued=0; one msp_change_requests row (id=1226, status=pending_approval, approved_by NULL) so changeRequestsAwaitingApproval=1; zero change_freeze_windows rows so freezeActive=false; zero tenant_engine_snapshots rows for customer_id=1 so every scores.* field reads null, not 0 (the live #4068 symptom this fix corrects).
